From the Crack in the Sky...!'') is the 31st chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Lillie]] learns from [[Mina]] that her [[Mohn|father]] is still alive. * [[Lusamine]] chases after {{p|Necrozma}}, forcing {{adv|Sun}}, {{adv|Moon}}, and [[Phyco]] to follow after them. * [[Faba]] learns an [[Ultra Wormhole]] opened above [[Mount Lanakila]] and enlists [[Plumeria]] to help deal with Lusamine. * With encouragement from [[Gladion]], Lillie changes her clothes and goes with [[Sina]], [[Dexio]], and [[Samson Oak]] to meet Lusamine. * The {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Zygarde Cells and Core}} enter the wormhole and go into the Reassembly Unit to become their Complete Forme. * Lusamine is defeated by Necrozma. * Moon tries capturing {{p|Nihilego}} again, but is blinded by a bright light, causing her to misfire. * Sun is knocked into the wormhole, sending him falling towards Mount Lanakila. {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Gumshoos}} * {{p|Tsareena}} * {{p|Palossand}} * {{p|Zygarde}} ({{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Complete Forme}}) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Sun}} * {{adv|Moon}} * [[Samson Oak]] * [[Ilima]] * [[Lana]] * [[Kiawe]] * [[Mallow]] * [[Acerola]] * [[Sophocles]] * [[Hala]] * [[Nanu]] * [[Hapu]] * [[Lusamine]] * [[Guzma]] * [[Lillie]] * [[Gladion]] * [[Plumeria]] * [[Sina]] * [[Dexio]] * [[Mohn]] (flashback) * [[Faba]] * [[Wicke]] * [[Zossie]] * [[Soliera]] * [[Phyco]] * {{tc|Aether Foundation Employee}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Meowth}} ([[Alolan form]];
